card.name: Strength words before CYP enzyme names
card.fires_on: The strength word (strong or moderate) right before CYP, usually in 'strong or moderate' or 'moderate or strong' pairs, in drug-interaction statements about CYP3A inhibitors or inducers.

modes.label: Second term of the pair
modes.description: 'strong' or 'moderate' follows 'or' and comes just before CYP3A.
modes.example: Avoid concomitant use of SKYCLARYS with moderate or<< strong>> CYP3A4 inhibitors.

modes.label: Single strength word
modes.description: A lone 'strong' directly before CYP3A in an interaction heading or sentence.
modes.example: With concomitant use of a<< strong>> CYP3A inducer, administer

card.writes: It pushes the model to output a capital C, as in the start of CYP, and away from lowercase c.
card.plain: It fires on 'strong' or 'moderate' when the next word will be the enzyme name CYP.
